name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code as a chat agent: models straight from the Claude Code CLI, effort per model, streaming, modes, resumable sessions, images, plan and cost — with allow/deny for every action. Ships executable code.
author: Lumen

settings.label: Path to claude
settings.hint: Leave empty to find claude on the PATH and in the usual folders (~/.local/bin, ~/.claude/local …).

settings.label: Default model
settings.hint: Applies while "Default" is chosen in the chat — e.g. opus, sonnet or claude-opus-5-5. The chat picker is loaded by Claude Code itself.

settings.label: Fallback model
settings.hint: Used when the selected model is overloaded.

settings.label: Offer older models
settings.hint: Adds older models to the model picker that Claude Code itself no longer lists (Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.1 …). Whether a model still answers for your account is up to Anthropic.

settings.label: More models
settings.hint: In addition to the Claude Code list — one model ID per line, optionally with "| Display name".

settings.label: Cache model list (minutes)
settings.hint: How long the Claude Code list is reused. The button next to the model picker reloads it immediately.

settings.label: Default effort
settings.hint: Applies while no effort is chosen in the chat. In the chat it can be set per model — only the levels the model supports are offered.

settings.label: Fast mode
settings.hint: Faster output on models that support it (costs more).

settings.label: Stream answers live
settings.hint: Shows text and reasoning while Claude writes.

settings.label: Maximum steps
settings.hint: Aborts an answer after this many tool rounds.

settings.label: Additional instructions
settings.placeholder: Answer in English. Prefer small changes …
settings.hint: Appended to the Claude Code system prompt — in addition to CLAUDE.md.

settings.label: Output style
settings.hint: Name of an output style, e.g. Explanatory or Learning.

settings.label: Save sessions
settings.hint: Off: conversations are not stored in ~/.claude and cannot be resumed later.

settings.label: Tools allowed without asking
settings.hint: One rule per line, as in the Claude Code settings.

settings.label: Denied tools
settings.hint: One rule per line. Denied tools are not available to Claude at all.

settings.label: More folders
settings.hint: Folders outside the project that Claude may access — one per line.

settings.label: Allow "No prompts" mode
settings.hint: Warning: in this mode Claude runs every command and change without asking. Use only in isolated environments.

settings.label: Additional MCP servers (JSON)
settings.hint: Like "mcpServers" in .mcp.json. The servers from the Claude Code settings apply anyway.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.description: Ask Claude about your project: explain code, find bugs, make changes. Every action asks for your permission first.
agents.placeholder: Message Claude …  (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, / commands, @ files)

modes.label: Ask
modes.description: Asks before every change and command

modes.label: Auto-accept edits
modes.description: File changes without asking, commands still ask first

modes.label: No prompts
modes.description: Runs everything without asking — must be enabled in the settings

suggestions: Explain the structure of this project.
Find possible bugs in the open file.
Write tests for the current selection.
